name: declaragent
description: Declarative, git-versioned AI agent platform. https://declaragent.dev

scripts.build: bun run --filter '@declaragent/core' build && bun run --filter '@declaragent/channel-*' --filter '@declaragent/source-*' --filter '@declaragent/plugin-*' --filter '@declaragent/testkit' build && bun run --filter '@declaragent/cli' build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter '@declaragent/core' typecheck && bun run --filter '@declaragent/channel-*' --filter '@declaragent/source-*' --filter '@declaragent/plugin-*' --filter '@declaragent/testkit' typecheck && bun run --filter '@declaragent/cli' typecheck
scripts.lint:docs: bun scripts/docs-command-lint.ts && bun scripts/env-vars-lint.ts && bun scripts/metrics-lint.ts && bun scripts/docs-policy-lint.ts
